articles.summary: Interface, Inc., the global flooring and sustainability leader, today introduced Twist & Texture™, its latest carpet tile collection featuring seven textile-inspired styles. For designers managing fast-moving projects, the collection pairs sophisticated design with one affordable price point and three-week QuickShip availability. Its color palette of warm neutrals and subtle accents gives designers the flexibility to create calm, inviting spaces across a variety of commercial environments.
articles.title: Interface Unveils Twist & Texture™ Carpet Tile Collection

articles.summary: Interface, Inc., the global flooring and sustainability leader, completed a pilot Social Life Cycle Assessment (S-LCA) of natural rubber used within select nora® rubber flooring products. The company is the first flooring manufacturer to publish an ISO-compliant S-LCA covering the life cycle of natural rubber production with one of its suppliers. The pilot helps build a broader understanding of product impact by exploring the people and communities connected to material production.
articles.title: Interface Completes Social Life Cycle Assessment of Natural Rubber​
